entry_thesis: Bitcoin has stabilized near $68,770 after the February selloff, and IBIT is seeing a decisive reversal in institutional flows — $199M in fresh inflows breaking a 5-week outflow streak. The SEC/CFTC joint commodity classification guidance (expected mid-March 2026) removes a major regulatory overhang, and BlackRock's IBIT now commands 45%+ of spot BTC ETF AUM, making it the cleanest vehicle to capture institutional re-entry without mining-stock execution risk or energy cost exposure that is pressuring MARA and RIOT.
risk: Bitcoin retests February lows near $60K if macro risk-off sentiment returns, dragging IBIT down 10-15% with it.
catalyst: IBIT spot inflow reversal ($199M after 5-week outflow streak) + SEC/CFTC commodity classification expected mid-March 2026 as regulatory clarity catalyst
